categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: aviation equipment and special refrigeration. Aviation equipment includes aviation oxygen systems, onboard inerting protection systems for fuel tanks, aircraft auxiliary fuel tanks, sensitive components, and ground oxygen equipment, serving military and some civil aircraft. The special refrigeration segment covers military and civilian refrigeration equipment, including air conditioning for military vehicles, ships, and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as oxygen regulation, onboard molecular sieve oxygen generation, nitrogen generation for fuel tank inerting, and integrated oxygen supply and anti-G systems. It employs digital flexible production lines, precision manufacturing, and system integration techniques. The company has developed internationally leading oxygen regulation technology and advanced molecular sieve oxygen generation, with extensive patents and industry standards contributions. Production is mainly customized, following a make-to-order model with small batch production and digitalized manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military clients such as the Air Force, Navy, Army, Rocket Force, and major aircraft manufacturers within the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC). The company also serves civil aviation markets, including large civil aircraft like AG600, C909, C929, and MA700, and provides products for aerospace applications such as space suits and space station life support. The special refrigeration products serve military vehicles, ships, and industrial sectors, with growing presence in civilian markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated within China, serving domestic military and civil aviation sectors. There is limited mention of export activities, mainly in special refrigeration equipment. The company’s facilities and headquarters are located in Hefei, Anhui Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream core component integrator and manufacturer within the aerospace and defense supply chain. It supplies critical subsystems such as oxygen systems, fuel tank inerting systems, and auxiliary fuel tanks to aircraft manufacturers and military end-users. It also produces specialized refrigeration equipment for military and industrial applications, positioning itself as a key system-level supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core technology capabilities, accelerating innovation in aviation oxygen systems, fuel tank inerting, and special refrigeration. The company emphasizes digital transformation, agile manufacturing, and system integration. R&D focuses on intelligent control, lightweight design, safety, and reliability, with significant investment in patent development and national-level projects. The company also pursues expansion into aerospace life support systems and diversified military and civilian markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized aviation equipment and special refrigeration products to military and civil aviation customers. The company follows a make-to-order production model, with pricing based on military pricing principles for defense products and negotiated pricing for civilian products. It also earns income from maintenance, repair services, and government subsidies related to R&D and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position as the sole specialized domestic manufacturer of aviation oxygen systems and onboard fuel tank inerting systems in China. It is the largest domestic producer of aircraft auxiliary fuel tanks and a leading manufacturer in the special refrigeration sector. Its main competitors are other domestic aerospace component suppliers and emerging private enterprises in the aviation equipment market. The company benefits from strong backing by AVIC and stable relationships with military and aerospace clients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, a 9.98% decrease from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 125.4 million, down 35.02%. R&D investment increased to 14.72% of revenue. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 3.62 billion and shareholders’ equity of RMB 2.5 billion. Despite recent revenue decline due to market and order delivery fluctuations, the company sustains stable operations with ongoing investment in innovation and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique position as the only domestic specialized manufacturer of aviation oxygen and fuel tank inerting systems, offering high-performance, reliable, and integrated life support and fuel safety solutions. Its products meet stringent military standards and support all domestic military aircraft and key civil aviation projects. The integration of advanced technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive testing capabilities differentiate its offerings. The company also provides customized, high-quality special refrigeration solutions for harsh military and industrial environments, enhancing operational safety and efficiency.
